verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a built-in KYC process for individual account holders exists, with KYC_BYO (bypass for pre-approved partners) and KYC_EXEMPT (reduced PII) pathways, implying core identity-verification logic is baked into issuance [lithic-docs-8, lithic-docs-22, lithic-docs-29]. However there is no evidence of KYB flows for business accounts, no documented data-requirement schemas, review/pending states, or re-verification triggers — missing for 10: KYB documentation for businesses, explicit data requirement lists, review-state lifecycle, and re-verification/refresh flows.
